By unlocking previously siloed data, we put timely awareness in front of the decision-makers who need it. As prime on the Air Force’s Installation Resilience Operations Command and Control (IROC) program, we hold a continuous Authority to Operate (ATO) and have proven the capability at scale at Tyndall Air Force Base. Remote: Quarterly travel to hub locations for team syncs and alignment. We look for builders who can comfortably navigate ambiguity and are deeply driven by our shared national security mission. People Always – Win as One Team: We foster a culture of psychological safety and mutual support. We operate as an integrated team where we assume noble intent as our default setting, ensuring that even the toughest feedback is rooted in trust. We trade our silos for a shared mission because collective impact always outweighs individual achievement. Empathize – Obsess Over the Customer: We don't just solve technical problems; we empathize and advocate for the operators using our products. We look beyond the surface to build what our customers—both internal and external—actually need to succeed, not just what they asked for. Focus – Ruthlessly Prioritize with Urgency: We focus on the highest-impact work and ruthlessly say no to distractions. We build resilient systems so that our solutions can repeat and scale under pressure. Let’s Go – Catalyze the Change You Seek: We don't wait for the industry to change; we drive it. We seek to understand why things are the way they are, but we never use “the way it’s always been” as an excuse. We aren't afraid to change course when the data or our mission demands it. What You’ll Do Troubleshoot and Resolve: Resolve network, OS, and cloud application access issues across hybrid environments. Safely execute automated scripts and remediation playbooks to resolve known issues while demonstrating disciplined production execution with operational rigor in live production environments. Support Ticket Triage & Escalation: Triage Support Tickets by directly resolving issues or gathering the telemetry, logs, and failure domain context required to execute a clean, actionable handoff to Engineering teams. Collaborative Queue & Ticket Management: Actively manage ticket priorities alongside the team. Identify queue overflows early and share the load to resolve high-priority issues quickly. Maintain precise, real-time ticket logs to prevent duplicate work and ensure seamless handoffs. Customer Communications: Translate technical findings into clear, complete, and empathetic updates for non-technical users. Observability: Actively monitor network health using DataDog and Splunk. CLI Operations: Use Linux command line and Windows PowerShell to verify system configurations, check local network states, restart stalled services, and safely execute pre-written remediation scripts without needing a full UI. Identity Management: Provision, troubleshoot, and manage user access across Active Directory (AD) and Okta. Toil Reduction: Actively look for ways to eliminate manual work. High-Stakes Execution: Maintain composure during mission-critical outages, providing clear, concise diagnostic updates to stakeholders while systematically working the problem. What You Bring Required Qualifications: Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a NOC, IT Operations, or hybrid Systems Support role, demonstrating a high degree of technical autonomy and operational discipline. Extreme Ownership & Detail Orientation: A habit of double-checking details (e.g., verifying identities and request specifics) before taking action. You take personal accountability for ticket resolution from intake to close—never shifting blame or leaving incomplete work for others. Cross-Domain Instincts: A "System of Systems" mindset with the ability to troubleshoot across multiple IT layers (Windows/Linux OS, Cisco switching, and Identity/Access). Observability Tools: Proven experience viewing, querying, and extracting actionable data from enterprise monitoring stacks like Splunk and DataDog. Networking & Linux: Practical experience navigating Cisco switch configurations via CLI, paired with comfort in a Linux command-line environment (SSH, grep, tailing logs, parsing daemons). Clear Communication: Proven ability to write clear, full-sentence updates for both internal engineering teams and external non-technical users.
